title: suck_pull: fetch_article reads and discards article body
description: suck_pull::fetch_article (suck_pull.rs:253-306) reads the dot-terminated article body from the wire but throws all bytes away — the loop at line 289 drains lines without accumulating them, and FetchResult::Fetched is returned with no content. There is no call to run_pipeline or enqueue_article anywhere in the import module. As a result the suck-pull import successfully negotiates NEWNEWS, downloads article IDs, sends ARTICLE commands, and receives article bytes — but stores nothing. Every 'fetched' article is silently dropped. Trigger: any run_suck_pull call. Bad behavior: summary.fetched increments but no articles are ingested into IPFS or the group log.
